sample_unit: Google FAQs on carpal tunnel release with paired ChatGPT answers

links.outcome: Readability and grade level of ChatGPT versus Google answers to carpal tunnel release FAQs
links.effect: ChatGPT answers were significantly longer and statistically significantly more difficult to read, at a higher grade level, than Google's answers across multiple readability algorithms.
links.quote: ChatGPT's answers were significantly longer than Google's and multiple readability analysis algorithms found ChatGPT responses to be statistically significantly more difficult to read and at a higher grade level than Google's.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's capability and readability when answering patient FAQs about carpal tunnel release surgery compared to Google, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
